title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Price Sheet: Included Plans by Series and Upgrade Prices
content:
Every window or door contract carries one Warranty Coverage plan, chosen when the contract is signed. Each product series includes one plan at no charge; a different plan is bought at signing at that plan's price per opening or door unit.

## Plan prices and the series that include them

| Plan | Upgrade price per opening or door unit (USD) | Product series that include the plan at no charge |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | 0.00 | Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl; Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door |
| Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty | 18.00 | Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl; Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door; Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | 34.00 | Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl; Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite; Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty | 52.00 | Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass; Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty | 74.00 | none — this plan is included with no series |
| Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty | 96.00 | Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad; Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door |

The price in the second column is the price per opening or door unit to buy that plan at signing instead of the series' included plan. A price of 0.00 marks a plan that is included and not sold as an upgrade.

## Reading the sheet

- A series appears against exactly one plan; that plan is the series' included plan.
- The Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty is never included with a series, so a contract carries it only when it is bought at signing.

## Worked figure (hypothetical contract)

A hypothetical Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl contract of eight openings includes the Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty. If the Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty is bought at signing instead, eight openings at 34.00 each come to 272.00.
